issue_summary: Theme and navigation behavior are centralized in shared files, so regressions propagate across most shared-shell pages.
recommendation: Audit shared-shell pages first after any styles.css or theme.js change; capture all four viewport/theme states plus keyboard and hover states.

issue_summary: Legacy Office-export page bypasses the shared shell, shared stylesheet, and shared theme behavior.
recommendation: Treat as standalone remediation project or migrate into current reading-page template before detailed scoring.

issue_summary: Long instructional pages include dense inline content, legacy imagery, and form controls that need rendered-state review for measure, focus, and mobile usability.
recommendation: Audit these pages early and decide whether to normalize them into the reading-page/lab-manual template.

issue_summary: Math 130 review pages use custom review templates and inline styling, increasing risk of inconsistent hierarchy, theme logic, and interaction behavior relative to shared course pages.
recommendation: Deep-audit one hub page and at least two review instances with different interaction density before broader remediation.

issue_summary: Several standalone tools do not share styles.css/theme.js, so focus treatment, dark mode behavior, and editorial alignment must be verified independently.
recommendation: Sample at least one simple tool and one app-like utility during the first full-audit cycle.
